summary: Braya Renewable Fuels (Newfoundland) LP is the manager-level Come By Chance renewable-fuels platform. The existing April 2023 ECP preferred-equity period already covers the census holding and must not be duplicated. Cresta is the current majority/controller and Silverpeak-managed NARC retains a minority interest; exact percentages, vehicles, voting rights and ECP close day are not publicly disclosed. The GP is governance only, the refinery is the asset, and government support remains non-equity.
